_doc: E2E pipeline fixture: 3 Whisper-style phrase segments with synthetic audio. Each segment contains 2-3 words of 250ms tone separated by 150ms silence. Segment boundaries include ~100ms trailing silence (realistic Whisper padding). Tests the full path: adapter segments → DP forced alignment → trailing silence trim → ValidatedWordSequence.
_note: Each segment has ~100-350ms trailing silence after the last word's tone ends, realistic of Whisper's segment padding. The aligner should trim trailing silence and place boundaries near tone-to-silence transitions.
